title: Gate the usable context, not the advertised maximum
description: Compare illustrative serving strategies at a required input length. Product-specific task, evidence-use, and latency floors determine which candidate is supportable.

profiles.label: Policy assistant
profiles.detail: Interactive answers must quote and cite the controlling policy text.

profiles.label: Repository assistant
profiles.detail: Cross-file changes prioritize task completion with traceable code evidence.

profiles.label: Regulated review
profiles.detail: Offline review tolerates more latency but requires very strong evidence attribution.

candidates.label: Direct full context
candidates.detail: Send the complete input to the model in one request.
candidates.tradeoff: Simple path; quality and latency degrade as irrelevant context grows.

candidates.label: Retrieval-assisted context
candidates.detail: Select a bounded evidence set before generation and preserve source identifiers.
candidates.tradeoff: Stable serving envelope; retrieval recall becomes a separate failure boundary.

candidates.label: Hierarchical synthesis
candidates.detail: Process sections independently, retain evidence links, then synthesize the final result.
candidates.tradeoff: Strong global coverage; orchestration adds latency and intermediate failure modes.
